name: transmembrane protein 131

function.text: TMEM131 is the approved symbol for transmembrane protein 131. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in collagen binding; collagen biosynthetic process.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Bladder urothelial carcinoma; Breast carcinoma; Cervical carcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: TMEM131 encodes transmembrane protein 131. Its functions include collagen binding and collagen biosynthetic process.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TMEM131 have been reported in breast carcinoma, cervical carcinoma, and lung adenocarcinoma. Recurrence alone does not establish the oncogenicity of an individual variant.
